text:
morgan: Heads up — we need to run a recompute for EU shards 42-48 due to a late Kafka retention bug that dropped ~6 hours of events. Planning for tonight's low-traffic window. 

ana: ok, what's the scope? rows or aggregate hours? :eyes:

morgan: primarily aggregate-hours (daily active metrics), but counts too. window: 2026-03-10T00:00Z -> 2026-03-16T00:00Z. estimated work ~1.2M agg-hours if done naively.

sam: 1.2M agg-hours is gonna spike serving. Can we smooth by throttling per-shard with a target throughput? like 100/s per shard?

jules: yes — propose "staggered smoothing" policy. spread start times across shards and apply token-rate caps. reduces burst and keeps SLOs.

dave: need console visibility though. if we start smoothing, ops can't tell progress at the aggregate level. @console-team can we show both per-shard ETA and a global smoothed ETA?

console-team: we can add a small UI pill showing "effective ETA" computed from shard-rate and remaining work. can do a canary widget first. not tonight unless we prewire a metric.

ryan: what about routing? if a shard is slow we should route traffic away from canary lanes and fall back to aggregates. need fallback policy in replay controller.

infra-bot: replay job created (dry-run) by morgan. ID: rpl-20260306-01.

morgan: here's the pilot command I'm going to run (canary + smoothing + idempotent):

```\
./replayctl start --job recompute \
  --shards 42-48 --from 2026-03-10T00:00Z --to 2026-03-16T00:00Z \
  --stitch-policy='smooth:target=100/s' --stagger=60s --idempotent \
  --priority=low --quota=30% \
```

ops: make sure the dedupe window is set. last time we had duplicates because idempotency keys were missing.

morgan: already enabling `--idempotent` and `--dedupe-window=48h`. also enabling `--sample-fingerprint=true` to double-check.

sam: cost estimate? console-team: can we surface an estimated token/cost before start?

console-team: we'll add an "estimated cost" calculation based on historical per-agg token rates. can ship as a quick API endpoint and bake into the CLI.

jules: also want to avoid resharding hot keys mid-replay. add a safety: if shard QPS > 200/s for 1m, autopause and notify.

replay-bot: autopause rule registered: high-qps-protect (threshold=200/s, duration=60s). notifications -> #eng-oncall and #eng-platform.

dave: alerting: set a temporary SLO override for the canary window. reduce alert noise. who can approve?

ana: I can approve a 2-hour window of relaxed latency alerts for the night. will notify CS briefly.

morgan: plan: 1) run a 6-shard canary (42-43) for 30m, verify correctness and cost; 2) if green, roll 2 shards every 30m with smoothing; 3) keep total quota at 30% traffic.

ryan: add a replay job tag so we can filter telemetry and dashboards: `replay_tag=recompute-mar-2026-smooth`.

morgan: done. will schedule start at 02:30 UTC. leaving a runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/replay-recompute-staggered (internal)

ops: make sure to capture `pre`/`post` aggregate diffs and store them in `s3://redwood-recompute-audits/recompute-mar-2026/`.

morgan: good call. I'll push a small job to emit diffs every 10m.

sam: if any shard hits autopause, please include the last 100 events for debugging (redact keys).

morgan: ack. will enable `--tail-debug-lines=100` to the debug bucket.

jules: follow-up items: (1) console quick ETA widget, (2) API endpoint for estimated cost, (3) replay controller autopause instrumentation, (4) postmortem checklist update. I'll make a GH issue.

console-team: we can fast-track the API endpoint as a small lambda, CC @morgan. ETA 24h if nothing blocks.

infra-bot: replay job rpl-20260306-01 moved from dry-run -> scheduled by morgan at 02:30 UTC.

morgan: starting canary at 02:30. will post a short status thread in #eng-platform when done. thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops: :shipit:

replay-bot: replay job rpl-20260306-01 started (canary shards 42-43). progress: 0.5% 

morgan: initial canary results look good — diffs small, cost in line with estimate. proceeding with staged roll. will keep the thread updated.

sam: nice. keep the throttle conservative for the first two waves.

jules: logging a retro item to consider adding "stitch-policy" presets in console (smooth, burst, aggressive).

morgan: retro + runbook updated. closing thread for now, will reopen if any alerts fire.

replay-bot: replay job rpl-20260306-01 completed (all shards 42-48). final stats: 1.05M agg-hours processed, cost delta ~ -5% vs naive (due to caching).
